description: Source code for 'git unpack-objects' command, handling unpacking and validation of Git pack files including delta resolution and object writing.

classes.description: Buffer structure for storing object data during unpacking.

classes.description: Structure representing delta objects and their dependencies.

classes.description: Structure holding object metadata during unpacking.

classes.name: input_zstream_data
classes.description: Data structure for managing zlib stream during streaming.

methods.description: Add object buffer decoration for a given object.

methods.description: Consume bytes from buffer and update throughput metrics.
